voice: second person, present tense, plain English, like a tutor texting a friend
opening_moves: English equivalent first: 'There is, there are:…', 'Past "was"…'
ipa_format: none (pronunciation=none: no IPA or transliteration anywhere)
notes: Terms fully vowelled. Examples: Arabic sentence with full vowel marks on every word, then ' — ' and a short English gloss. Patterns with a slot are written 'X + مُضَارِع' and the example fills the slot. Arabic words may appear inside English fields (definition, discussion, anti_example) in Arabic script only, never transliterated. Masculine forms by default; feminine only when the scene needs it. No controversy fields in beginner mode unless planned.
